is_anopheles.evidence: The study monitors Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data for any of the listed insecticide-resistance markers. It mentions that the Akron strain has resistance mediated by L1014F kdr and Ace-1R (page 6), but this is a description of the strain's known characteristics, not new genotype data generated in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for any field-collected mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in the Zou region of Benin.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating ITN durability.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was performed in the Cove, Zagnanado and Ouinhi Districts (COZO) of the Zou Department of central Benin.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between March 2020 and November 2023.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary durability study embedded in a cRCT.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is missing.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the attrition, physical integrity, and insecticidal durability of two dual-active ingredient ITNs (Interceptor G2 and Royal Guard) compared to a pyrethroid-only ITN (Interceptor) in Benin. The study did not perform any genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers in field populations.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: No new genotype data for resistance markers is reported.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided.
